basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software engineer from Austin, Texas. I recently got into gaming and find the PlayStation community fascinating. Outside of work, I enjoy exploring vegan recipes and watching reruns of 'Two and a Half Men'. I'm usually online in the evenings after work, around 6-9 PM CST. I'm single and enjoy spending time with friends on weekends, either gaming or trying out new vegan eateries.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science with a focus on software development. Most of my gaming knowledge is self-taught, learned through online forums and YouTube tutorials. I'm also interested in sustainable living and social justice, which I explore through online communities.
